evidence.reason: The fixture creates a temporary repository and sets only user.name/user.email before committing, so it inherits a developer or CI-global `commit.gpgSign=true`. In that case Git attempts to sign the fixture commits, and without a matching signing key the commit fails, causing every `DeployTests` case that uses this fixture to error in `setUp()`. This is an ordinary hermeticity/test-reliability defect; setting repository-local `commit.gpgSign=false` before the first commit is the smallest compatible fix and also covers the later fixture commits without altering the developer's global configuration.
